product_overview: A comprehensive web-based clinical management application designed to streamline patient management, session workflows, report generation, and billing for healthcare professionals with integrated AI and cloud services.
core_goals: Provide a secure and seamless user authentication and session management experience.
Enable efficient patient and appointment management through a powerful CRM dashboard.
Facilitate AI-powered clinical report generation including voice transcription and text inputs.
Offer a focused clinical session workspace with audio recording capabilities.
Integrate with Google Drive for secure cloud storage following a zero-knowledge architecture.
Provide flexible billing and subscription management using Stripe.
Include universal search capabilities across patients and reports.
Ensure smooth onboarding and user profile management.
Deliver comprehensive statistics and analytics for user insights.
key_features: User authentication and session management using Supabase with server-side rendering support.
Dashboard featuring calendar, appointments, quick actions, and statistical overviews.
Patient management including lists, detailed profiles, and new patient creation with CRM functionalities.
AI-powered report generation with voice transcription and text input support leveraging OpenRouter and custom server functions.
A dedicated session workspace for managing clinical sessions with audio recording and playback.
Google Drive integration for secure report storage using zero-knowledge principles.
Billing system with pricing plans, subscription handling, and Stripe payment gateway integration.
Universal search module covering patients and reports for quick retrieval.
File upload support for document and audio files.
User profile management focusing on professional data and preferences.
Responsive navigation and layout components built with Shadcn/UI and Tailwind CSS.
Statistics and analytics dashboards visualizing key usage data and metrics.
Custom React hooks to boost performance and usability, including debouncing and mobile-specific utilities.
Onboarding flow for new users to facilitate initial setup and education.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) page for user support.
user_flow_summary: User signs up or logs in through a secure authentication system using Supabase authentication flows.
Upon successful login, users land on a dashboard displaying their calendar, upcoming appointments, quick action buttons, and overall statistics.
Users can navigate to the patient management section to view, create, and edit patient profiles and access historical data.
When conducting a session, users enter the session workspace where they can record audio, take notes, and generate clinical reports with AI assistance.
Generated reports are saved securely with an option to store them on Google Drive under a zero-knowledge protocol to ensure data privacy.
Users manage their subscription plans and billing details from the account section, with Stripe handling payments and credits management.
Users utilize a universal search bar to quickly locate patients or reports across the system.
New users are guided via an onboarding process to configure their profile and understand platform features.
Users can access FAQs for help and troubleshooting.
validation_criteria: Authentication system supports user signin, signout, session timeout, and proper error handling.
Dashboard loads appointment data, statistical summaries, and quick actions without delay and updates in real-time.
Patient management allows creation, editing, and deleting patients with data saved correctly to the database.
Report generation produces accurate AI-generated content with successful voice transcription and text input handling.
Session workspace accurately records and plays back audio with no data loss.
Google Drive integration successfully stores and retrieves reports preserving zero-knowledge privacy guarantees.
Billing system processes payments securely using Stripe, handles different subscription tiers, and updates credit status.
Search module returns relevant results quickly for both patients and reports.
File uploads accept expected file types and sizes and correctly link files to patient records or reports.
User onboarding is intuitive and completes without errors.
Statistics visualizations reflect up-to-date and accurate data.
UI components render consistently across supported browsers and screen sizes.
